name: Puong Cave
kicker: Boat passage on the Nang River
summary: Puong Cave is the river passage you ride through by boat on the Nang. Stay seated under the ceiling. It shares the long boat with Dau Dang. The cave is about 1 km downstream from Buoc Lom. The fee and the time inside are Check on arrival.
getThere: About 1 km down the Nang from Buoc Lom. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The cave mouth from the boat, with the river and the cliff beyond

notice.title: Stay quiet under the bats
notice.body: Footsteps, torchlight, and talking wake the colony. Stay seated in the boat.

body: You stay seated while the boat goes through. Stalactites hang over the water. The story told here is that the Nang was blocked, a giant cut the mountain, and the rock he threw back became Dau Dang. The cave is in xa Ba Be, Thai Nguyen, under the limestone of Lung Nham, northeast of the lake. Older lines still place it in huyen Ba Be, Bac Kan.

The cave is 300 m long, with a ceiling of 30–40 m and an average width of about 30 m. It holds 23 bat species. The animals are counted as tens of thousands and as hundreds of thousands. Both counts stay. The through-ride shares the long boat with Dau Dang. The time inside is Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The river and the cliff, seen from inside the mouth
figures.alt: Looking out of Puong Cave at the Nang River and a forested limestone cliff

gettingThere: From a night at Pac Ngoi the same boat joins this cave to the lake circuit and, when the circuit is the long one, to Dau Dang. The cave start at Buoc Lom is about 1 km down the Nang. The cave is also 5 km from the old town of Cho Ra. That figure is the cave, not a walk from the market to Pac Ngoi.

legs.heading: From Buoc Lom
legs.body: By boat, about 1 km down the Nang. Minutes for that kilometre are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cho Ra
legs.body: 5 km from the old town of Cho Ra. Older lines still place the cave in Bac Kan. Minutes and a fare are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Check on arrival. The long circuit is one boat with Dau Dang.
